source: Separate sprite sheets referenced against the approved Cyberbien character reference.
preparation: Transparent crops normalized onto 1254 × 1254 PNG canvases. The picker uses the existing WebP preparation step.

sheets.prompt:
Create a production sticker SPRITE ATLAS of exactly SIX separate illustrations of the SAME established Cyberbien cyber security bee from the image reference, on a TRUE TRANSPARENT alpha background. Landscape atlas with precisely 3 columns and 2 rows. Center coordinates fractions: (1/6,1/4), (1/2,1/4), (5/6,1/4), then (1/6,3/4), (1/2,3/4), (5/6,3/4). All stickers equally sized, each well inside its own invisible square cell with at least 9% empty transparent safety margin on all sides. No panel, overlap, grid lines, or source collage. Cropped head and torso bust plus gestures and explicitly listed icon prop, no feet. One clean distinct silhouette each, soft polished dimensional 3D character art. Preserve the source's bright golden rounded bee face, TWO short black antennae with round warm yellow tips fully visible, eyes with white sclera and dark irises, chunky goggles resting above eyes with cyan coding bracket icon in left lens and padlock icon in right lens, dark navy hoodie with yellow drawstrings and shield emblem, black gloves, hints of pale wing shapes behind shoulders. Only expression, pose and explicit prop vary. Hold props close to body, keep symbols simple and readable at 48px. Small highlights should stay within objects. No words, labels, captions, backgrounds, shadows on the ground, color halos, white outlines, watermarks or checkerboard. True alpha outside each sticker.
